description_en: Create work items for a project, such as requirements, defects, tasks, risks, and themes
description_zh: 创建工作项，可以用于创建项目下的工作项，包含（需求、缺陷、任务、风险、主题等）
name: CreateWorkitemV2

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL of your organization on Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The category of the work item. Valid values: `Req`, `Bug`, `Task`, and `Topic`
parameters.help_zh: 工作项的类型id，枚举值为：Req、Bug、Task、Topic
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The description. To upload an image, we recommend using images smaller than 1 MB. To insert an image, use the following format: \ where ****the asterisks (\) represent the Base64-encoded image content, and `png` is the image format. Replace `png` with the actual image format
parameters.help_zh: 描述，描述区上传图片，推荐只上传小于1M的图片，请在接口description字段中插入如下格式： \ 其中******为图片内容的base64编码，png为图片的格式，按实际图片格式填写即可
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The unique identifier of the field
fields.name: field_identifier

parameters.help_en: A list of field values. Call the Get Workitem Fields List API (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460486.html) to determine the available fields for the specified work item type
parameters.help_zh: 字段值列表，可以通过获取工作项字段列表接口 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460486.html)获取对应工作项类型有哪些字段可以设置
parameters.name: field_value_list

parameters.help_en: A list of participant account IDs
parameters.name: participants

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the project
parameters.name: space_identifier

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the sprint
parameters.name: sprint_identifier

parameters.help_en: The title of the work item
parameters.name: subject

parameters.help_en: A list of unique tag identifiers
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，填写标签唯一标识列表
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: A list of tracker account IDs
parameters.name: trackers

parameters.help_en: A list of unique version identifiers
parameters.help_zh: 版本列表，填写版本的唯一标识列表
parameters.name: versions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the work item type. Call the Get Workitem Types API (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460485.html) to get the available types for the project
parameters.help_zh: 工作项类型id，可以通过获取工作项类型接口 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460485.html)，查看对应项目下有哪些工作项类型可以选择
parameters.name: workitem_type_identifier

errorCode.description_en:
The error code returned if the request fails (when `success` is `false`).

An empty string is returned if the request succeeds (when `success` is `true`)
errorCode.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误码；
 
当success为true，返回空值

errorMessage.description_en:
The error message returned if the request fails (when `success` is `false`).

An empty string is returned if the request succeeds (when `success` is `true`)
errorMessage.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误信息；

当success为true，返回空值

requestId.description_en: The unique request ID. Use this ID for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

workitemIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the work item
